title: Where to Go in the East Village of Des Moines
abstract: A once-desolate downtown edge is redefining the urban heart of Des Moines.

title: In Victoria, British Columbia, Where to Go on Trounce Alley
abstract: Trounce Alley, a tiny Euro-chic pedestrian passage connecting two busy downtown thoroughfares, has emerged as a diverse micro hub.

title: Where to Go in Melville, Johannesburg
abstract: While some lament that the bohemian enclave’s glory days have passed, others enjoy its clutch of antiques shops, independent designers and good dining.
